user.title: Docan Panda & Deye EMS
user.description: Set up the experimental read-only beta. Connect to a compatible local Deye logger/gateway, or use existing HA sensors. Physical hardware and firmware compatibility are not yet field-verified. This integration cannot operate your equipment.

restore.title: Restore household settings
restore.description: Paste an exported settings document. Review the local connection details or sensor bindings on this HA; a direct connection is tested again. Tibber credentials are never exported and must be entered again.

hardware.title: Your battery and inverter
hardware.description: Docan Panda 32 kWh is the battery profile. A working wired battery-to-inverter BMS link is mandatory; power cables alone are insufficient. Select the actual BMS protocol. Direct battery-to-HA readings use a separate RS485-to-USB adapter. All inverter/BMS profiles remain experimental.

connection.title: Connect the inverter
connection.description: Choose your local adapter protocol. A Solarman V5 logger uses its own framing (usually port 8899); it is not plain Modbus TCP. A gateway must already be wired and configured for Modbus TCP or transparent RTU. Choose existing sensors if another integration already polls this equipment; avoid competing pollers. No separate Deye integration is required for direct mode.

equipment.title: Local equipment connection
equipment.description: Enter the local IP from your router and the configured port/unit address. For Solarman V5, enter the logger serial number printed on the logger, not the inverter serial. Next performs fixed telemetry reads only. No network scan or device configuration occurs. The battery BMS connection must already work.

data.host: Logger or gateway local IP address

equipment_check.title: Check the live readings
equipment_check.description: The device reports a low-voltage three-phase hybrid profile. Battery: {battery_soc}% at {battery_voltage} V, {battery_power} W, {battery_current} A. Inverter: {inverter_power} W. Home: {load_power} W. Grid: {grid_power} W. DC solar: {solar_power} W. Compare these with the inverter screen. Battery positive means discharge; grid positive means import. Confirm only when the readings and directions match. Exact firmware/model compatibility still requires field verification.

data.readings_match: These readings and directions match my inverter

measurements.title: Connect your local measurements
measurements.description: Select sensors already provided by your Deye/battery/meter integration. Values must have compatible units. Whole-home power must include every load you want shown. Set signs explicitly: normalized battery positive = discharge; grid positive = import. Optional daily energy counters reset daily. Maximum age uses the last report, even if the number is unchanged.

location.title: Sun and home location
location.description: Optional sun map. Map/weather providers receive selected coordinates and your browser network address. Disabling the map removes its saved location. Solar forecasting has a separate location and consent setting.

data.enabled: Enable sun map and external map/weather requests

home.title: Choose your home location
home.description: Enter your address as a private label, then place the map pin at your home. Only the selected coordinates are used for the map and weather. Your address is not sent to the price provider.

solar.title: Your solar installation
solar.description: Enter the total installed panel capacity in kWp (not instantaneous kW). Choose DC solar connected to Deye, another AC inverter, mixed, or no solar. Direct Deye DC mode reads both MPPTs automatically; leave the sensor blank. External AC/mixed setups require a separate combined production sensor. Mixed installations show aggregate production; this beta does not invent an AC/DC split or a yield forecast.

pricing.title: Your electricity prices
pricing.description: Choose Tibber for its final household import tariff, Nord Pool for spot plus your taxes and supplier fees, or a local compatible price-curve sensor. The full current delivery day must be available before planning is ready.

tibber.title: Connect Tibber
tibber.description: Enter your personal Tibber token. This integration only queries homes and prices; it cannot alter your subscription or hardware. HA stores the token privately in its configuration. Keep an existing token by leaving this field empty during reconfiguration.

tibber_home.title: Choose your Tibber home
tibber_home.description: Choose the home whose electricity tariff applies to this installation.

nordpool.title: Nord Pool bidding area
nordpool.description: Select the price area for your electricity contract. HA timezone defines the delivery day. Your import tariff is calculated on the next page.

sensor.title: Local price curve
sensor.description: Select a sensor with a date attribute (YYYY-MM-DD), unit currency/kWh or currency/MWh, and periods containing timezone-aware start, end and value. Optional export values are a separate compensation tariff. A current-price-only sensor is insufficient.

data.basis: Prices are final all-in or raw spot

tariff.title: Household taxes and fees
tariff.description: For spot prices: final import = (spot + tax + supplier fee) × (1 + VAT/100). Enter per-kWh amounts in the selected currency before VAT. For all-in prices, tax, fee and VAT must stay zero to avoid double charging. Fixed monthly charges are excluded. Export fees apply only to a separately supplied export price; import prices are never assumed to be export compensation.

plan.title: Where should the plan come from?
plan.description: Choose the forecast optimizer, a simple charging estimate, a supplied plan, or the advanced production policy comparison. All modes are read-only. The production comparison needs a complete observation frame and does not use solar forecasts or price anticipation.

observed.title: Observe your controller plan
observed.description: Select a sensor with date, updated_at (timezone-aware), and windows containing timezone-aware start/end plus action charge, export or idle. Its timestamps must be refreshed within your maximum age. No installation-specific entity names are needed.

limits.title: Shadow charging assumptions
limits.description: Enter values appropriate to your installation; This integration will not commission or change them. These estimate-only limits do not authorize hardware operations. The deadline is today in HA local time. After it passes, any unmet target is shown as unreachable.

finish.title: Create the household dashboard
finish.description: Create {name} for {model}. Plan source: {plan}. The sidebar dashboard and read-only entities are added automatically. No plant control is enabled.

battery.title: Battery readings and mandatory RS485 link
battery.description: Direct Docan mode requires an RS485-to-USB adapter between the battery and HA host (9600 baud, 8N1). Enter your serial path from HA hardware settings and the configured battery address. No scanning or device configuration occurs. This is separate from the battery-to-inverter BMS cable. Do not share a serial port with another poller. Choose existing/inverter readings if you already have a battery reader.

battery_check.title: Confirm direct battery measurements
battery_check.description: Battery reports {battery_soc}% at {battery_voltage} V, {battery_current} A and {battery_power} W. Temperature: {battery_temperature} °C; cell spread: {battery_cell_delta} V. Positive current/power means discharge. Compare with the BMS display. This decoder does not certify BMS alarms or protections.

data.readings_match: These values and directions match my battery display

export_tariff.title: Separate selling tariff
export_tariff.description: Enter NET export compensation per kWh in your contract currency, including applicable selling fees. Zero explicitly means no compensation; negative means you pay to export. It is never inferred from import prices. Curve mode requires a compatible price sensor with export values. Fixed mode does not apply the export fee again.

data.export_mode: Fixed net price or separate curve values

forecast.title: Forecast inputs and learning
forecast.description: Forecast.Solar uses one panel orientation and sends the selected coordinates, tilt, azimuth and kWp to its service after consent. Azimuth: south 0°, east -90°, west 90°. For multiple orientations use an aggregated forecast sensor with updated_at and complete start/end/kwh periods. Enter expected average home load for cold start; a local time-of-day profile learns after 3 complete historical days per interval. Price anticipation needs 3 historical price days and remains labelled estimated. Efficiency learning requires a dedicated battery AC power sensor, positive discharge: never select whole-inverter or grid power.

data.consent: Allow Forecast.Solar to receive these location and panel details
data.baseline_load_kw: Expected average home load until history is learned (kW)
data.anticipate_prices: Estimate unpublished tomorrow prices from local history
data.learn_efficiency: Learn efficiency from dedicated battery AC/DC readings
data.battery_ac_power: Dedicated battery AC power sensor (optional learning)

optimizer.title: Read-only optimization limits
optimizer.description: These assumptions constrain a simulation; no controls are enabled. Capacity is 32 kWh. Limits must match your installation. Target applies to today’s deadline, terminal charge applies to the horizon end. Export simulation uses your separate compensation. Battery export on estimated prices is off by default. Wear cost is per DC kWh discharged. The planner does not assume that excess solar can be curtailed; impossible limits produce no feasible plan.

data.cycle_cost_per_kwh: Wear cost per DC kWh discharged
data.allow_battery_export: Include battery export in the simulation
data.export_on_anticipated: Allow simulated battery export using anticipated prices

production.title: Production policy comparison
production.description: Advanced shadow comparison for the 10 kW reference profile. Select a sensor carrying the complete controller observation frame described in ENGINE_PORT.md. This calculates decisions and proposed settings without sending commands. It requires 96 published quarter-hour prices in EUR. Enter your tariff deduction; no other household's fee is supplied. This reference policy uses one price curve for planning; the separate fixed/curve selling tariff from the forecast optimizer does not apply. Solar forecasts and anticipated prices do not affect this policy.

data.fallback_reserve_soc: Reserve fallback when no dated measurement is available (%)
data.export_price_deduction: Controller export-value deduction from the input price (EUR/kWh)

inputs_not_ready.title: Household observations need attention
inputs_not_ready.description: {name} has missing, stale or incompatible measurements, prices or a plan. Open its dashboard for the affected inputs, then reconfigure the integration. It remains shadow-only and cannot operate equipment.
